## 问题与结果 / Problem and result

说明触发问题、修改后的行为，以及关联的 Issue。 / Describe the trigger, resulting behavior, and any related issue.

## 验证 / Validation

列出实际执行的检查与结果；未执行的项目说明原因。 / List checks actually performed and their results; explain omitted checks.

- [ ] `npm run content:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] 涉及界面时验证相关 Preview 流程 / Verify affected preview flows for interface changes.

## 内容与审校 / Content and review

- [ ] 中文、英文与共享 ID 已同步，或本次不涉及知识单元 / Both languages and shared IDs are consistent, or no knowledge unit is affected.
- [ ] 修改文案已执行对应 Humanizer 编辑和单独语义复核 / Changed copy has language editing and a separate semantic check.
- [ ] 审校记录对应当前内容；注明 AI 辅助与实际核查范围 / Review records match current content; disclose AI assistance and actual review scope.
- [ ] 来源定位和许可已核对，或没有新增第三方材料 / Source locators and licenses are checked, or no third-party material is added.

## 限制 / Limitations

记录未解决问题、可能影响与不适用的检查项。 / Record unresolved issues, possible impacts, and inapplicable checks.
